description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeLicenseDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests various methods such as retrieving, deleting, searching, saving, and editing employee license records, as well as related functionalities involving allowed licenses and counts.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for EmployeeLicenseDao, testing CRUD operations and license retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeLicenseDao, and populates test data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an employee's license by its identifiers.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests deletion of specified employee licenses.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests searching employee licenses with filters.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLicenseWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching employee licenses with a limit constraint.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee license.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests editing and updating an existing employee license.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeLicensesCount
methods.description: Tests counting employee licenses based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicenses
methods.description: Tests retrieval of allowed licenses for employees.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Tests counting of allowed licenses for employees.
